scope: Independent Studio workspaces and opt-in industrial Arcade appearance layer. Software evidence only, not production recipe admission, artwork approval, human acceptance, a gameplay completion proof or release qualification.

focused.supplemental: After the exact-builtin-identity guard was tightened to preserve byte-identical custom uploads, all10 industrial-arcade and studio-runtime-transfer tests passed again.

verification.eslint: Owned JavaScript files: zero warnings or errors.

independentReview.scope: Legacy source identity, exact picture binding, uploaded image precedence, alpha/geometry/rotor preservation and per-attempt selection.
independentReview.result: Passed; sufficient for unchanged legacy behavior evidence, not theme art approval.

observed: Create and persist independent workspace; reload retains workspace.
Workbench exposes independent Workspace, Industrial, Windows Classic and DOS specimens; switching to Windows Classic leaves editor preferences unchanged.
Industrial comparison loaded both real Team painter boards and35 native original/derived sprite pairs.
Industrial board preserves pilot-number markers, contact rings, objective labels and tile footprints.
limits: Initial-state static specimen only; no full playthrough, performance, touch/controller or physical-device acceptance claimed.

baselineFailures.method: Node module loader reads tracked game/authoring .mjs source from the recorded Git HEAD. Existing HTML/data fixtures remain unchanged; no working-tree file is replaced.

cases.assertion: Retry expects preparing but remains error.

cases.test: controller skip cannot carry held Confirm into Retry

cases.assertion: firstEnemySpan <18 fails in the deliberate missing-width handoff check.

baselineFailures.conclusion: The same seven assertions fail against HEAD sources and current sources; not attributed to the industrial adapter. Not waived or represented as passing.

verification.integration: Final shared interface provider adds UI-only font resolution independently of Arcade artwork. Parent verified32painter tests and12theme-contract tests; Plain and legacy defaults retained.
verification.authoringLint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js authoring/**/*.mjs --max-warnings 0: exit 0, all authoring JavaScript clean. Changed workbench status subscription also linted and formatting checked.

finalReview.scope: Studio transfers, workspace ownership, actual candidate previews and legacy defaults.
changes: Workbench observes shared host status, clears warning on recovery, and disposes the subscription.
New Industrial workspace seeds from selected verified release assets, flattens history while keeping provenance parents and original bytes.
RuntimeTheme.v2 contains compiled Presentation, derived ThemeFamily.v1/InterfaceTheme.v1 candidate and exact installed-engine SIM dependency.
Arcade comparison uses current workspace bytes; editing/switching closes stale comparison.
Same-tab SIM calibration receives bounded candidate data after staged work is saved.
limitations: Runtime transfer has no arbitrary player-theme installation UI. Procedural SIM resources must be present in the installed engine.
Restored Arcade attempts retain authored art; per-attempt appearance choices are not yet saved as separate pins.
SIM candidate handoff previews the exact builtin material/model/effect collection; it does not import arbitrary executable shaders, geometry or external resource URLs.

crossDomain.scope: Final runtime v2 envelope, legacy runtime v1 reader, editable authoring roundtrip, exact source/SIM coupling and changed-byte rejection, bounded one-shot candidate preview/expiry/injection/quota, workspace persistence invariants and static release graph.

observed: New verified-release-seeded industrial workspace; changed panel token survives actual save and reload.
Full authoring export is 8,471,687 bytes; compact runtime v2 export is 3,444,497 bytes with source revision2 and edited #252d27 panel token.
Actual selected-workspace Team comparison renders35 native sprite pairs and labels the matching workspace revision.
candidateBrowser.note: Script was corrected to wait for completed save acknowledgement instead of the already-staged r2 summary before reloading. No source data-loss bug was found.

observed: Created new Industrial workspace seeded from the verified release, changed panel token to #252d27, saved to completed acknowledgement, and reloaded with the edit retained.
Full .rltheme export was 8,471,687 bytes; compact runtime v2 export was 3,444,497 bytes with matching workspace revision2 and edited token.
Actual current-workspace Team comparison rendered35 native sprite pairs.
Clicked the Studio SIM preview link; calibration received the same workspace@2 and applied candidate panel #252d27.
Actual SIM renderer selected industrial-workshop@r1. LocalStorage remained unchanged and browser errors were empty.
studioToSimBrowser.limits: Authoring transfer and browser rendering evidence only; no arbitrary player-theme installation, production admission, human art approval or physical-device qualification claimed.

retainedProduction.action: No compiled files or production ledger changed. All six current HEAD recipe source closures already differ from compiled104; whole-producer refresh would include unrelated prior changes.
